summary: Scoped independent source review of changed catalog, purchasing, periodic stock-count, immutable inventory-evidence and v4 Rules boundaries. Current server Auth, canonical same-hotel membership, action permissions and subscriptions control access. Protected browser writes and generic import bypasses are denied; typed bounded inputs, transactional evidence and exact retries preserve integrity. Local emulator checks passed. This assessment is not a whole-application or production certification.
resolvedDuringReview: Purchase option identity preserved through cart/order/receipt/reversal

Unlinked receipts produce explicit inventory coverage gaps
Recursive location write grant narrowed; evidence uses private top-level hotel paths
New and unfinished historical counts require complete explicit quantities
Late postings and count-time postings remain visible without revaluing saved reports
Positive receipt cost independent of rounded per-unit cost
Import prefixes and saved command retries remain exact after uncertain responses
Current Auth rechecked after real SDK transaction retries and revocation
Legacy ambiguous package variants blocked equally in client and backend
Mixed net/gross/unknown purchase totals blocked; explicit basis shown without historical tax inference
